description: Check status, confirmations, gas and fee for up to 8 transactions across Ethereum, Base, Arc and BNB Chain. $0.003 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

txs.description: up to 8 comma-separated chain:0xhash items, e.g. base:0x...

name: tx_batch_status
title: Tx batch status
